text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's Valentine's Day, and Manhattan Cafe
has
invited me to the empty classroom
she's using.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Right now, right in front of you... there's
a box of
chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Can you see it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However hard I squint, I can't see
anything. I
answer honestly, and...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
And because you can't see it... it doesn't
exist?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that a little strange? I mean, you
can't see
my friend either, can you?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: But you believe she exists...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You said the chocolates don't exist, but
you
believe my friend does...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So... what's the difference?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She does have a point. But after some
thinking, I
figure out what the difference
might be...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Do you... have an answer?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
So, if I believe something exists... you do
too?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I see...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: It's because... you're like that, that I...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um, here you go...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe takes out an actual box
of
chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But she doesn't hand it over
immediately.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Right now, in front of you, there's a
box of
chocolates.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Can you see it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the urge to play a little trick on
her. I
wonder how she'll react if I say the
opposite of
what she expects.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's there. Really. A box of chocolates I
made
myself...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
You have to tell the truth... I tried really
hard with
these...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I've upset her a little. Maybe getting to
see that
expression on her face is my
second Valentine's
gift.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She continues with the questions.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Do you think these chocolates were
made... with
love?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Try using your imagination...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe is shrouded in mystery. I
feel like
she wouldn't put her love into
some chocolates so
easily.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...They were made with love. You might not be able to see it, but it's there...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Because I believe it is.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: And now... for my last question.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Once you accept my gift, you can't give
it back.
Knowing that... will you take it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I struggle with my decision... And as I
mull things
over...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A powerful force shoves me from
behind, as if to
drive me forward.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't think there's any way out.
